**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/27 (Sat) 08:48
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It is common for 401(k) plans to offer profit-sharing as a feature; approximately 55% of 401(k) plans offered profit-sharing in 2020.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The specific percentage of plans offering profit-sharing may vary depending on the source of the data and the criteria used to define a "401(k) plan."
- [USER] Asked what 401(k) plans do not offer profit sharing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Not all 401(k) plans offer profit-sharing; smaller employers or businesses may opt not to offer it due to cost or complexity.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Profit-sharing is not a legal requirement under the law; it is up to the plan sponsor (usually the employer) to determine the specific features of the plan.
- [USER] Asked what is the smallest company that offers profit sharing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Even small companies can offer profit-sharing; a small business with only a few employees may have a simple profit-sharing plan.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Small businesses may partner with financial services providers to set up a 401(k) plan with profit-sharing features.
- [USER] Asked what industry is profit sharing offered the most.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Profit-sharing is more commonly offered in industries such as management consulting, financial services, information services, manufacturing, and wholesale trade.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The decision to offer profit-sharing depends on the employer and factors like company size, profitability, and competition for skilled workers.
- [USER] Asked for an example of a profit-sharing software tool.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] An example of a profit-sharing software tool is "Performio," which is a cloud-based performance management and commission tracking software.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Performio allows companies to set up and automate profit-sharing plans, calculate payouts, and generate reports.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Another example is "CaptivateIQ," which is a commission management platform that can handle different types of incentive compensation programs, including profit-sharing.
- [USER] Asked for others.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Other examples of profit-sharing software tools include Gusto, Shareworks by Morgan Stanley, ADP, Oracle HCM Cloud, Bonusly, and HRCloud.
- [USER] Asked what is the average revenue.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The average revenue for small businesses in the U.S. was $1.2 million in 2020, but this varies by industry.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Average revenue for small businesses in healthcare was $1.7 million
